## About
The Cool Saguaro is family-owned and community-trusted. We're a licensed, bonded and insured plumbing and HVAC contractor based on W Adams St in Phoenix, and an accredited business with the BBB.
We work on homes and businesses across Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa, Glendale, Gilbert and Chandler. Whether it's fixing a leak, tuning up your AC or upgrading your whole system, we'll take a look, give you an estimate and help you pick a day and time that works.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 rating on Google from 127 reviews. Luis gets thanked by name in our reviews, and one reviewer wrote that the owner is very friendly.

## Services
- Maintenance: Regular upkeep for your AC, heating and plumbing so things keep running through the Phoenix summer. One family has used us several times for maintenance and service work.
- Service & Installation: Service and installation for heating, cooling and plumbing systems.
- Commercial & Residential: We work on homes and businesses alike.
- Plumbing repairs: Dependable plumbing repairs and installations, from leaks to outdoor spigots.
- New AC units: Help choosing and installing a new air conditioner, with time to answer your questions.
- Mini split units: One customer had Luis solve problems left by a previous improper installation of 2 mini split units.
- Water heaters: One customer says Luis replaced their water heater and also services their HVAC systems.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call after hours?
A: Yes. We're available around the clock in Phoenix and the surrounding areas, every day of the week.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa, Glendale, Gilbert and Chandler.

Q: How do estimates work?
A: Call or use the form on our website to ask about a complimentary estimate. We'll look over your needs and equipment, give you an estimate, then help you pick a day and time.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: One reviewer mentioned convenient financing options when buying a new AC unit. Give us a call and ask what's available.
